scope: minimal remediation of the three blocking trust-boundary residuals the independent auditor found in v1.5.1: F1 symlinked `_survivors` root, F2 relative `source_run.attempt_dir`, F3 non-string `kanban_task_id`. No leaderboard ordering change, no survivor/family gate change, no B v2 launch, no cron enablement, no frozen artifact touched, no service/daemon/queue/Registry/Orchestrator added.

F1_symlinked_reserved_root.defect_v1_5_1: `_survivors` itself being a symlink onto the frozen round directory resolved the boundary onto that frozen directory (realpath on both sides), so `--out <root>/_survivors/verdict.json` returned rc=0 and overwrote the frozen verdict, `--out-dir <root>/_survivors` wrote leaderboard files inside the frozen round, and the `forward` append created `forward/` there.
F1_symlinked_reserved_root.fix_v1_5_2: new `reserved_root()` / `reserved_root_problem()` in runtime/survivor_index.py: the reserved root must not be a symlink and its realpath must equal `<realpath(results-root)>/_survivors`; `outside_write_boundary()` returns the refusal before any write, and it is now applied to index `--out`, leaderboard `--out-dir` and the `forward` append.
F1_symlinked_reserved_root.observed_v1_5_2: index --out <root>/_survivors/verdict.json rc=1 (stderr: `the reserved post-survivor root … is a symlink … outside the reserved post-survivor write boundary …`); leaderboard --out-dir rc=1; forward rc=1; no leaderboard.json/csv, forward/ or survivor-index.json appears in the frozen round; frozen verdict/bundle sha256 unchanged; control: same root with a real `_survivors` directory writes rc=0.
F1_symlinked_reserved_root.observed_v1_5_1: same regression in the 84f494c worktree: FAILED — `0 != 1 : index=…/_survivors/verdict.json result=written` (the index wrote through the symlink onto the frozen verdict).

F2_relative_source_run_attempt_dir.defect_v1_5_1: `os.path.realpath(source_run.attempt_dir)` resolved a relative path against the reader's cwd, so a genuine DONE run expressed relatively was accepted from the results-root cwd and the same slice was refused from the repository cwd.
F2_relative_source_run_attempt_dir.fix_v1_5_2: source_run_problems() refuses any non-absolute `attempt_dir` before resolution; the absolute path must still realpath inside the results root and outside `_survivors/**`, keep the run-id directory name, and match the terminal DONE sentinel + pinned result.json checksum + field-by-field `forward_slice`.
F2_relative_source_run_attempt_dir.observed_v1_5_2: relative attempt_dir with cwd = results root → rc=1 (`source_run.attempt_dir … is not an absolute path`), no jsonl appended; identical slice with the absolute attempt_dir → rc=0 / `appended` (control).
F2_relative_source_run_attempt_dir.observed_v1_5_1: same regression in the 84f494c worktree: FAILED — `0 != 1 : appended survivor=sv-… cohort=SOLUSDT/4h 2026-09-11..2026-09-30 slices=1`.

F3_non_string_ownership_id.defect_v1_5_1: the ownership check was truthiness + equality only, so the same non-zero JSON number (or bool/list) in both `family.json` and the bundle was accepted as provenance — self-consistent, hence invisible to the identity/checksum check.
F3_non_string_ownership_id.fix_v1_5_2: entries_for_bundle() requires a non-empty string on BOTH sides and string equality; any int/bool/list/null/empty string fails closed even when both sides carry the same JSON value.
F3_non_string_ownership_id.observed_v1_5_2: kanban_task_id = 12345 / true / "" / ["t_1f97bf6b"] / null on both sides → si.build() returns no index and `source ownership is incomplete - kanban_task_id is not a non-empty string on both sides`; control with "t_1f97bf6b" on both sides still indexes 2 survivors.
F3_non_string_ownership_id.observed_v1_5_1: same regression in the 84f494c worktree: FAILED — the index was built with two survivors carrying `kanban_task_id: 12345`.
